title: Downlink Starvation in Shared LoRaWAN Cells: Simulator and Experiments
description: Discrete-event simulator of a shared EU868 LoRaWAN cell, experiment scripts and raw results for the paper 'Downlink Starvation in Shared LoRaWAN Cells: Attacks by Authenticated Devices and Per-Tenant Downlink Budgets' (SysCom 2026).
